CITY OF SAN MARINO

  CITY COUNCIL AGENDA

Steven W. Huang, DDS, Mayor  www.SanMarinoCA.gov
Gretchen Shepherd Romey, Vice Mayor  (626) 300-0700 Phone

Tony Chou, Council Member  City Hall Council Chamber

Calvin Lo, Council Member  2200 Huntington Drive
Steve Talt, Council Member  San Marino, CA 91108

Philippe Eskandar, City Manager

  ADJOURNED REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL
  FRIDAY, MAY 31, 2024 AT 8:30 AM
  CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  2200 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Council
with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. Typically,
adjourned meetings are held on the last Friday of every month at 8:30 a.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the City Clerk via email at CityClerk@SanMarinoCA.gov or by phone at (626)
300-0705 prior to the meeting for assistance.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the
meeting will proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City will
do it’s best to resolve any technical issues as quickly as possible.

How to view or listen to the meeting from home:
  Visit www.SanMarinoCA.gov/Zoom

How to offer public comment from home:

  Public comment will be accepted by email to CityClerk@SanMarinoCA.gov until 3:00
  p.m. the day before the meeting. Written public comment received by 3:00 p.m. will
  be distributed to City Council during the meeting. Any comments received after 3:00

AGENDA – MAY 31, 2024  Page 1 of 5
   p.m. will be included in the public comment record but not provided to City Council at
  the meeting.
  Written public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference
  module during the meeting. Written Zoom comments will be accepted after the in-
  person comments.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Council Member Chou, Council Member Lo, Council Member Talt, Vice Mayor Shepherd
Romey, and Mayor Huang

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the Stoneman
Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.SanMarinoCA.gov.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the City Council by
completing a public comment card and giving it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting. At
this time, the public may address the City Council on items that are not on the agenda.
Pursuant to state law, the City Council may not discuss or take action on issues not on the
meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The Mayor reserves the right to place
limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.

  NEW BUSINESS

 1.  ADOPTION OF MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING WITH THE CITY
  EMPLOYEES’ ASSOCIATION, FIREFIGHTERS’ ASSOCIATION, POLICE
  OFFICERS’ ASSOCIATION, RESOLUTION NO. R-24-16, APPROVING A
  COMPENSATION PLAN FOR UNREPRESENTED EMPLOYEES, AND
  RESOLUTION NO. R-24-20, APPROVING CONTINUATION OF EMPLOYEE
  CONTRIBUTION OF IAFF MEDICAL EXPENSE REIMBURSEMENT PLAN

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council adopt the MOUs with all of
  the employee associations, adopt Resolution No. R-24-16, and adopt Resolution No.
  R-24-20. If Council concurs, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to…

AGENDA – MAY 31, 2024  Page 2 of 5
   Adopt the Memorandum of Understandings for the City Employees’ Association,
  Firefighters’ Association and Police Officers’ Association;

  Adopt Resolution No. R-24-16, amending Resolution No. R-24-04 and approving
  a compensation plan for unrepresented employees; and
  Adopt Resolution No. R-24-20, to approve employee contributions to the IAFF
  Medical Expense Reimbursement Plan Effective July 1, 2024.”

 2.  PRESENTATION AND ADOPTION OF THE PROPOSED OPERATING &
  CAPITAL BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2024-25

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council adopt Resolution No. R-24-
  17, adopting the Operating and Capital Budget for Fiscal Year 2024-25, adopt
  Resolution No. R-24-19, amending Resolution No. R-21-10 to include Fee S-073
  Bus/Van/Valet Parking Permits, adopt Resolution No. R-24-14, adopting the Salary
  Schedule for FY 2024-2025, and adopt Resolution No. R-24-15, approving new job
  classifications/specifications for the position of part-time Special Projects Coordinator.
  If the Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to adopt (1) Resolution No. R-24-17, Adopting the Operating and Capital
  Budget for the Fiscal Year 2024-25 and Appropriating the Amounts Specified therein
  from the Funds and for the Purposes Indicated; (2) Resolution No. R-24-19 amending
  Resolution No. R-21-10 to Include Fee S-073 Bus/Van/Valet Parking Permits; (3)
  Resolution No. R-24-14, Adopting the Salary Schedule for FY 2024-2025; and (4)
  Resolution No. R-24-15, Approving New Job Classifications/Specifications for the
  Position of Part-Time Special Projects Coordinator.”

 3.  APPROVAL OF SAN MARINO CENTER RENOVATION PROJECT NO. 20-
  1000 PARTIAL RELEASE OF RETENTION IN THE AMOUNT OF $300,000
  TO CABD CONSTRUCTION AND DISCUSS USE OF REMAINING
  FURNITURE, FIXTURES & EQUIPMENT AND CONTINGENCY BUDGET

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council 1) approve Item #1 for the
  installation of the lower rooftop screening, 2) approve partial release of the project’s
  retention payment in the amount of $300,000 to CABD Construction, and 3) provide
  direction on the remaining Items #2-4.

  If the Council concurs, an appropriate motion would be:

  Option 1:

  “I move to approve Item #1 related to the San Marino Center Renovation (lower roof
  screening), and direct staff to partially release the project’s retention payment in the
  amount of $300,000 to CABD Construction.”

  Option 2:

  “I move to approve Item #1 and (insert any combination of items #2, #3, and #4)

AGENDA – MAY 31, 2024  Page 3 of 5
   related to the San Marino Center Renovation, and direct staff to partially release the
  project’s retention payment in the amount of $300,000 to CABD Construction.”

  CONSENT CALENDAR

 4.  APPROVAL OF RESOLUTION NO. R-24-18 ESTABLISHING  THE
  APPROPRIATIONS LIMIT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2024-25

  Recommendation: Staff recommends adoption of the proposed FY 2024-25
  appropriations limit and the appropriations subject to limitation for the City of San
  Marino. If the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate
  motion would be:

  “I move to approve Resolution No. R-24-18, Establishing the Appropriations Limit and
  Appropriations Subject to Limitation for Fiscal Year 2024-25.”

 5.  APPOINTMENT OF MEMBERS TO CITY OF SAN MARINO ADVISORY
  BODIES

  Recommendation: The Council Liaisons for the Planning Commission recommend the
  Council appointment of three (3) regular members and one (1) alternate member to
  serve four-year terms, each commencing on June 1, 2024.

  The Council Liaisons for the Design Review Committee recommend the Council
  appointment of three (3) regular members and one (1) alternate member to serve
  two-year terms, each commencing on June 1, 2024.

  The Council Liaisons for the Public Safety Commission recommend the Council
  appointment of two (2) regular members to serve four-year terms each commencing
  on June 1, 2024.

  The Council Liaisons for the Library Board of Trustees recommend the Council
  appointment of two (2) regular members to serve three-year terms each commencing
  on June 1, 2024.

  If Council concurs, the appropriate motions would be:

  “I move to appoint Kevin Cheng, Sharon Mequet, and Joyce Gatsoulis Batnij as regular
  members and Brett Leitner as an alternate member of the Planning Commission to
  serve terms ending May 31, 2028.”

  “I move to appoint Raymond Cheng, Ted Lee, and Steven Jones as regular members
  and Nora Hoyos as an alternate member of the Design Review Committee to serve
  terms ending May 31, 2026.”

  “I move to appoint Charles Martinson and Eliot Hodges as regular members of the
  Public Safety Commission to serve terms ending May 31, 2028.”

AGENDA – MAY 31, 2024  Page 4 of 5
   “I move to appoint Vivi Wahl and Genevieve Chien as regular members of the Library
  Board of Trustees to serve terms ending May 31, 2027.”

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTION

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City
received by members of the City Council. All public writings distributed by the City of San
Marino to at least a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be
made available at the Public Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San
Marino, California 91108, and will also be included in the public agenda packet that will
available for review at the City Council meeting.

ADJOURNMENT

  CITY CLERK
